chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 285: Li Huowang Joins the Office & Bai Lingmiao Refuses to Be Left Behind
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang joins the Supervisory Heavenly Office but must choose between the Zuowandao hunt and Bai Lingmiao’s homecoming. She refuses to be left behind ever again.
og_title: Departure—Li Huowang’s First Test as a Supervisory Officer
og_description: Bai Lingmiao plants her feet and refuses to be left behind. Li Huowang finally has access to information—but the Zuowandao won’t wait.
twitter_title: The emotional gut punch of Ch. 285: Bai Lingmiao says NO
twitter_description: Li Huowang tries to split the group again. Bai Lingmiao brings up his own funeral. The team is set for battle.

lore_anchors.definition: A local administrative record of major events; an empty or sanitized gazetteer in the Dao-Twisted World signals official complicity or denial of supernatural horror.
The assistant in a spirit-dance ritual; often silent and puppet-like, but its relationship with the medium can deepen into personal affection. Bai Lingmiao calls hers “Sister.”
A rare human constitution that makes a person valuable as an alchemical ingredient and subject to ontological Bewilderment—schizophrenia, reality slippage, or divine targeting.
The “Way of Sitting in Forgetfulness,” a perversion of Daoist meditation into a cult of joyful deception. They are tricksters who weaponize uncertainty.
In this novel, not just a feeling but a cosmic condition—the inability to distinguish reality from hallucination, which can become a worldly law.
